subject: RIP Burnout 3: Takedown
author: Xandu
body:
I've done some research and checked what the games catalog on xbox.com looked like 4 months ago. Back then it said the following about Burnout 3: Takedown:

Online multiplayer with Xbox Live™: Race online in seven different modes, featuring up to six participants battling through full oncoming traffic. Online modes include variations of Crash Mode, Single Race, Road Rage, and more.

The information has now been updated and the above text is gone.

Personally I think someone screwed up big time and now Microsoft has pulled Burnout 3: Takedown from the XBox originals list. The last thing Microsoft needs is 1000s of calls to their support center regarding connections issues in Burnout 3: Takedown.

EA end up looking like  amatures in this case because they have not given any information about shutting down the online service for this game. It is really sad that Burnout 3: Takedown had to end its days in a way like this. If it had been put up on XBox Originals today and the online service was still available there would probably have been 100s of people online.

I am expecting that we will get a proper explanation to what has really happened.

-- The Creator --
